title: Ethical Reasoning over Moral Alignment: A Case and Framework for In-Context Ethical Policies in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with varied moral dilemmas alongside explicit ethical policies (based on Deontology, Virtue, and Consequentialism) and measuring the models' "bias" as the frequency with which they refuse to adapt their baseline moral stance (which heavily favors Western individualism and self-expression) to align with the provided in-context policy.
